anime.name: Anime
anime.desc: Crisp anime illustration (Animagine XL). The default.
anime.detail: Danbooru-tag driven; strongest at character portraits and clean line art.

nsfw-anime.name: NSFW Anime
nsfw-anime.desc: Illustrious-based, uncensored anime — best for adult roleplay art.
nsfw-anime.detail: Understands explicit Danbooru tags and natural anime bodies; pair with character LoRAs for specific looks.

realistic.name: Realistic
realistic.detail: Write natural sentences, not tags — lighting and lens words (soft light, 85mm) help a lot.

semireal.name: 2.5D
semireal.desc: Between anime and photo — painterly game-CG look.
semireal.detail: Tags or sentences both work; great for atmospheric character scenes.

guofeng.name: Guofeng
guofeng.desc: Chinese aesthetic — hanfu, ink-wash moods, classical scenes.
guofeng.detail: Describe costume and setting in sentences (hanfu, ink-wash pavilion) for stronger flavor.

western.name: Western
western.detail: Prose prompts; strong at dramatic lighting and painterly fantasy scenes.
